environment.description: Application deployed on GKE Autopilot cluster (1.28+) with Binary Authorization enforcing attestation. Pod runs with the following securityContext: runAsNonRoot=true, readOnlyRootFilesystem=true, allowPrivilegeEscalation=false. The node pool has COS_CONTAINERD image with the hardened kernel. A GKE Sandbox (gVisor) runtime class is specified on the pod (runtimeClassName: gvisor). The gVisor sentry intercepts all syscalls; critically, it implements awk/subprocess execution through its own restricted syscall table where the 'system' and 'popen' families used by awk's system() function return EPERM. Additionally, a Kubernetes NetworkPolicy restricts egress to only the metadata server and internal ClusterIP services. The pod's service account has Workload Identity bound to a GCP SA with zero IAM bindings beyond monitoring.metrics.write.
